title: encrypt: EnvelopedData version should be V0 for KTRI-only, not V2
description: RFC 5652 §6.1 specifies EnvelopedData.version as: 0 if all recipient infos are KeyTransRecipientInfo and no attribute certificates, 2 if any recipient is KeyAgreeRecipientInfo or KEKRecipientInfo. In encrypt.rs, the version is hardcoded to CmsVersion::V2 regardless of recipient types. When all recipients are RSA (KTRI), the version must be V0. Some strict CMS parsers (e.g. older OpenSSL) may reject an EnvelopedData with version=2 when all recipients are KTRI. Trigger: calling encrypt() with RSA-only recipients produces a non-conformant version field.
